subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: Should OpenClaw add a provider-neutral agent/session usage contract for optional provider-reported charges, beginning with OpenRouter, or keep agent-visible cost limited to the existing local estimates?
rationale: The requested feature changes the public meaning of usage and cost across agent runtime, session state, and presentation. Source evidence establishes the gap, but cannot choose the permanent exact-versus-estimated API and fallback semantics.

options.title: Add a sourced provider-cost contract
options.body: Carry optional provider-reported USD cost separately from local estimates through the generic usage/session path, with OpenRouter as the first producer.

options.title: Keep estimates as the only core surface
options.body: Retain local estimates in core and direct exact OpenRouter billing presentation to an external plugin or user integration.

options.title: Defer until broader session usage API work
options.body: Resolve the generic `session_status` usage API direction first, then add provider-charge fields as part of that unified contract.

recommendation.title: Add a sourced provider-cost contract
recommendation.body: Carry optional provider-reported USD cost separately from local estimates through the generic usage/session path, with OpenRouter as the first producer.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant current-main history and the earlier maintainer-facing review concentrate on the shared transport and session-usage contract.
